description: Room client library: RoomClient class that manages WebSocket connection, E2EE key exchange, and event emission. Handles connect, sendMessage, on() event listeners. Automatically performs E2EE key exchange on connection and emits 'ready' when encryption is established. Updates roomStore with connection state.
steps: 1. Create apps/web/src/lib/room-client.ts. Define RoomClient class with constructor(roomId: string, peerId: string, displayName: string).

2. Add private properties: ws: WebSocket | null, keyPair: { publicKey, privateKey } | null, sharedKeys: Map<string, CryptoKey> (peer ID -> shared key), eventHandlers: Map<string, Function[]>, connectionState: 'disconnected' | 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'ready'.

3. Implement connect() method: Constructs WebSocket URL (ws://localhost:8787/ws/{roomId}?peerId={peerId}&name={displayName}). Generates ECDH key pair. Opens WebSocket. On open, broadcasts key-exchange message with exported public key. Sets up message handler.

4. Implement WebSocket message handler: Parses incoming WSMessage. If type='key-exchange', imports peer's public key, derives shared secret, stores in sharedKeys map. When all peers have exchanged keys (check sharedKeys size vs peers count), emit 'ready' event and set connectionState to 'ready'. If type='peer-joined', emit 'peer-joined' event with peer data. If type='peer-left', emit 'peer-left' event. For other messages, decrypt if E2EE is enabled and emit 'message' event.

5. Implement sendMessage(type: string, payload: unknown, encrypt: boolean = true) method: If encrypt=true and connectionState='ready', encrypts payload with each peer's shared key. Sends WSMessage via WebSocket. If encrypt=false, sends plaintext (used for key-exchange).
6. Implement on(event: string, handler: Function) method: Adds handler to eventHandlers map. Returns unsubscribe function.
7. Implement disconnect() method: Closes WebSocket, clears sharedKeys, sets connectionState to 'disconnected'.
8. Add integration with roomStore: On 'peer-joined', update roomStore.setPeers(). On 'peer-left', update roomStore.setPeers(). On 'connected', update roomStore with connection state.
9. Export RoomClient class as default export.
acceptance_criteria: RoomClient constructor accepts roomId, peerId, displayName
connect() establishes WebSocket connection and automatically initiates E2EE key exchange
on() method allows subscribing to events: 'connected', 'peer-joined', 'peer-left', 'message', 'ready'
After key exchange completes with all peers, 'ready' event fires indicating encryption is established
sendMessage() encrypts payloads before sending when encrypt=true and connectionState='ready'
disconnect() cleanly closes connection and clears state
TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors
verification: Manual two-tab test: Create RoomClient in each tab, call connect(), verify 'ready' event fires in both tabs after key exchange, send encrypted message from one tab, verify receipt in other tab
findings: Implementation complete. RoomClient class created in apps/web/src/lib/room-client.ts with all required functionality: (1) Constructor accepts roomId, peerId, displayName. (2) connect() establishes WebSocket connection and automatically initiates E2EE key exchange with ECDH key pair generation and public key broadcast. (3) WebSocket message handler processes key-exchange messages, derives shared secrets using crypto.ts functions, and tracks peers. When all peer keys are exchanged, emits 'ready' event and sets connectionState to 'ready'. (4) Handles peer-joined and peer-left messages, updating local peer list and roomStore. (5) sendMessage() supports optional encryption parameter, encrypts payload when encrypt=true and connectionState='ready'. (6) on() method allows event subscription with unsubscribe function return. (7) disconnect() cleanly closes WebSocket and clears state. (8) Integrates with roomStore: updates on peer-joined/peer-left and connection state. (9) Exported as default export.
